variants.name: Frau Löffelrecht

variants.personality_en: She regards the wall as an unresolved question of cutlery.
variants.field_note_de: Sie hält die Wand für eine Frage des Bestecks.

variants.name: Herr Bewährungsangst

variants.field_note_de: Die Freiheit erschien ihm auf der Packliste etwas übersichtlicher.

variants.name: Herr Schließzustand
variants.prompt_excerpt: MEDIUM narrow upright pear ink blob, stiff sideways crown curl, thick upper lip and ONE crooked upper tooth. Half-lidded judgmental side-eye, CLOSED pursed lip. Holds ONE enormous old brass KEY and ONE short fat blunt lock pick together low at belly, simple readable tools.
variants.personality_en: He objects to locks mainly on procedural grounds.
variants.field_note_de: Ein Schloss ist für ihn eine unbegründete Zuständigkeit.

variants.name: Frau Fernverdacht
variants.prompt_excerpt: TALL leaning inverted-drop ink splat, TWO antenna-like rounded crown lobes, subtle lashes, asymmetrical upper fangs. One eye CLOSED and one WHITE/red/black very wide looking outward, crooked small tense mouth. Hugs ONE stubby thick battered BRASS SPYGLASS at her own belly, not looking through it or pointing at another actor.
variants.personality_en: She has seen trouble coming and would like it to make an appointment.
variants.field_note_de: Sie sieht Schwierigkeiten früh genug, um sich rechtzeitig zu sorgen.

variants.name: Herr Leerlauf
variants.prompt_excerpt: WIDE low upright bean splat with a huge coiled crown loop, ONE square lower tooth, sleepy drooping lids. Exhausted unimpressed WHITE/red/black gaze and enormous CLOSED pout. Holds ONE small three-spoke BLACK rubber steering wheel with iron hub, loose in both goo hands, no car.
variants.personality_en: He is ready to leave as soon as everyone stops making this urgent.
variants.field_note_de: Er wartet mit laufendem Zweifel.

variants.name: Frau Atemvorbehalt
variants.prompt_excerpt: TALL curving upright ink pear, high flowing crown quiff, long lids/lashes, TWO offset ivory upper teeth. One eye blissfully shut and one sideways, strong curved closed lip. Holds ONE short beautifully rounded BRASS SAXOPHONE with thick curved bell and THREE large keys at own belly, mouthpiece clear of face.
variants.personality_en: She considers silence a promising place to begin a disagreement.
variants.field_note_de: Sie beginnt dort, wo die anderen eine Pause vorgesehen hatten.

variants.name: Herr Grundton
variants.prompt_excerpt: VERY WIDE low heavy upright ink splat, three blunt crown lobes, single big lower tusk. Low patient half-lids, CLOSED solemn downturned lip. Hugs ONE compact fat WOODEN DOUBLE BASS with short neck and THREE thick strings, entire instrument at belly with NO endpin/floor, goo face/body dominant.
variants.personality_en: He keeps the group together by refusing to hurry.
variants.field_note_de: Er trägt den Grundton wie eine bereits getroffene Entscheidung.

variants.name: Herr Nebenbeat
variants.prompt_excerpt: SMALL narrow tilted upright goo bean, one springy crown hook, FOUR tiny irregular upper teeth. Both WHITE/red/black eyes wide and asymmetric, delighted sideways clenched-tooth grin. ONE small copper-rimmed SNARE DRUM strapped LOW to own belly, ONE short fat wooden stick in each goo hand, no kit/stool.
variants.personality_en: He heard the pause and has taken responsibility for correcting it.
variants.field_note_de: Er übernimmt ungefragt die Verantwortung für jede freie Sekunde.

variants.name: Frau Lautantrag
variants.prompt_excerpt: BROAD upright triangular ink splat, THREE thick crown waves like soft goo mohawk, lashes, TWO big uneven lower teeth. Defiant furious OPEN underbite SHOUT, one eye squeezed, no tongue. Holds ONE fat old black MICROPHONE with copper stem at belly, no stand or cable.
variants.personality_en: She has submitted the complaint at its intended volume.
variants.field_note_de: Die Beschwerde wurde in angemessener Lautstärke eingereicht.

variants.name: Herr Akkordresten
variants.prompt_excerpt: TALL thin stooping-but-UPRIGHT bean, long drooping crown lobe, ONE off-centre upper ivory fang. Suspicious concentrated crosswise gaze, CLOSED lip biting tooth. Hugs ONE short rounded battered mustard ELECTRIC GUITAR with plum pickguard and THREE fat strings, no amp/cables.
variants.personality_en: He knows one chord thoroughly enough to distrust the others.
variants.field_note_de: Drei Akkorde hält er für eine unnötige Streuung der Zuständigkeit.

variants.name: Herr Eimermaß
variants.prompt_excerpt: VERY ROUND low upright ink dumpling, TWO tiny side crown nubs, large soft lower lip and THREE sparse upper teeth. Enormous delighted open tooth LAUGH, one eye shut, NO tongue. Holds ONE dented upside-down steel BUCKET as a small belly drum, ONE short fat wooden kitchen spoon for striking, no floor.
variants.personality_en: He brought the instrument that was available and now considers it essential.
variants.field_note_de: Der Eimer hat sich als künstlerisch belastbar erwiesen.

variants.name: Tante Letztentscheid
variants.prompt_excerpt: WIDE upright heavy bell ink blob with TWO rolled crown curls tied in tiny ivory kerchief, lashes, ONE huge upper tooth. Terrifyingly cordial CLOSED crooked smile, high rounded brows and one half-lid. Holds ONE squat old cream PORCELAIN TEAPOT with thick copper lid, no cup/pouring.
variants.personality_en: She has invited everyone to enjoy the day according to her arrangement.
variants.field_note_de: Der freie Tag folgt ihrem verbindlichen Vorschlag.

variants.name: Herr Familiensonntag
variants.prompt_excerpt: TALL very narrow drooping ink pear, one long sagging crown hook, TWO small offset lower teeth. Unequal white/red/black eyes look UP, tired worried sagging underbite. Hugs ONE small cream PLATE holding ONE lonely crumbled toast corner, all attached to own hands.
variants.personality_en: He was told there would be no obligations today.
variants.field_note_de: Er hatte unter Freizeit etwas mit weniger Teilnehmerpflicht verstanden.

variants.name: Opa Zeitreserve
variants.prompt_excerpt: COMPACT almost-square ROUND-lobed upright ink splat with three low crown nubs, heavy wrinkled lids, single ivory lower tusk. Offended teeth-clenched sideways stare. Both goo hands hold ONE enormous old copper ALARM CLOCK with fat bells and BLANK face with TWO physical hands only, no digits.
variants.personality_en: He arrived early to establish that everyone else was late.
variants.field_note_de: Er war früh da, um die Verspätung der anderen festzustellen.

variants.name: Frau Hauptabsperrung
variants.prompt_excerpt: TALL broad upright rounded trapezoid ink blob, TWO strong sideways crown curls, lashes, THREE uneven upper teeth. One brow high and other eye narrowed, CLOSED compressed severe lower lip. Holds ONE thick old red PIPE WRENCH, short and beautifully rounded, no pipe maze.
variants.personality_en: She can stop the leak as soon as everyone stops explaining it.
variants.field_note_de: Sie kann das Wasser abstellen, sobald alle mit dem Reden fertig sind.

variants.name: Herr Dichtungslehre
variants.prompt_excerpt: SMALL lanky tilted ink bean, one springy crown nub, ONE enormous square lower tooth. Huge wide asymmetric eyes DOWN, crooked nervous lip. Carefully holds ONE massive black RUBBER WASHER with clear round hole as though it were the missing answer, no extra tools.
variants.personality_en: He has found the spare part and is waiting to discover what it replaces.
variants.field_note_de: Er hat das Ersatzteil gefunden. Der zugehörige Fehler fehlt noch.

variants.name: Herr Abnahmetermin
variants.prompt_excerpt: VERY WIDE low upright ink splat, three thick blunt crown lobes, two tiny upper fangs, thick heavy lower lip. Disapproving nearly closed WHITE/red/black eyes, CLOSED lip folded into a long pout. Hugs ONE short silver PIPE ELBOW fitted with ONE chunky brass pressure gauge, blank face/two thick hands only; compact self-contained prop.
variants.personality_en: He has detected a discrepancy between the water and the paperwork.
variants.field_note_de: Das Wasser entspricht nicht dem dokumentierten Zustand.

variants.name: König Vielleichtmorgen
variants.prompt_excerpt: WIDE upright chunky ink splat, one split crown curl, TWO uneven lower tusks. Panicked side-looking WHITE/red/black eyes and crooked clenched teeth. Tiny battered copper CROWN tilted too far, short terracotta plaid collar. Holds ONE short thick dull ceremonial DAGGER low at own belly, no blood/action/victim.
variants.personality_en: He has acquired the crown and misplaced the future.
variants.field_note_de: Seit der Krone fehlt ihm eine zuverlässige Zukunft.

variants.name: Frau Zwischengewebe

variants.personality_en: She has made waiting into a craft with deliberately reversible progress.
variants.field_note_de: Sie hat das Warten zu einer widerrufbaren Fertigkeit entwickelt.

variants.field_note_de: Er besteht darauf, dass Gäste sich an die Hausordnung halten.

variants.name: Herr LetzterAusschank

Tiny IVORY dinner-jacket LAPEL COLLAR with BLACK bow tie only. Holds ONE stout small coupe GLASS with thick amber clay drink, no bar or human suit.
variants.personality_en: He keeps a place open for people who are about to leave.
variants.field_note_de: Er hält einen Platz frei für Leute, die gleich abreisen.

variants.name: Frau Abschiedsvorbehalt
variants.prompt_excerpt: TALL slender upright pear ink blob, TWO soft rolled crown curls beneath small cream travel hat, gentle lashes, TWO tiny lower teeth. One eye wide and one heavy lid, determined sad CLOSED curved mouth. Short ivory scarf collar, both hands hold ONE folded blank cream LETTER against own belly, no hands reaching toward another character.
variants.personality_en: She has made a decision that refuses to become a simple memory.
variants.field_note_de: Der Entschluss weigert sich, eine einfache Erinnerung zu werden.

variants.name: Herr Prinzipienreise
variants.prompt_excerpt: MEDIUM tall upright rounded trapezoid ink splat, THREE short asymmetric crown nubs, solitary upper fang and firm lower lip. variants.personality_en: He carries the papers as though departure were a collective responsibility.
variants.field_note_de: Die Abreise ist für ihn eine gemeinsame Verpflichtung.

variants.name: Herr Würdeverlust
variants.prompt_excerpt: TALL thin upright drooping ink bean with one long crown hook, ONE big lower tusk. Weary nearly closed WHITE/red/black eyes, heavy CLOSED downturned lip. variants.personality_en: He has seen enough honour to prefer a quieter drink.
variants.field_note_de: Er kennt genug Ehre, um ein ruhigeres Getränk vorzuziehen.

variants.name: Herr Umfangseid
variants.prompt_excerpt: VERY WIDE ROUND upright ink splat, THREE proud fat crown lobes, THREE big uneven upper teeth. Huge exuberant OPEN tooth laugh with NO tongue, raised asymmetrical brows. variants.personality_en: He regards modesty as an unsuitable container for the available material.
variants.field_note_de: Bescheidenheit wäre für den vorhandenen Inhalt zu klein.

variants.name: Madame Hintergedanke

Small blue brimmed cap and short ivory neck tab. Holds ONE small plain LEATHER PRAYER BOOK with brass clasp, other goo hand supports ONE very short rounded RAPIER HILT with a SHORT blunt blade fully inside own cell.
variants.personality_en: She has prepared a sincere explanation for every possible allegiance.
variants.field_note_de: Für jede Zugehörigkeit liegt eine aufrichtige Erklärung bereit.

variants.name: Ritter Zustandsbild
variants.prompt_excerpt: TALL spindly-but-thick upright ink bean with TWO long soft crown lobes, solitary upper tooth and long lower lip. Ecstatic determined one-eye squint, crooked clenched uneven teeth. Tiny old iron COLANDER HELMET worn as brow cap, short terracotta collar. Holds ONE short bent wooden LANCE with a fat blunt cork-like tip, wholly inside cell, no horse/windmill/attack.
variants.personality_en: He recognises the world chiefly by what it ought to have been.
variants.field_note_de: Er erkennt die Welt daran, was sie seiner Ansicht nach hätte sein müssen.

variants.name: Herr Bodenhaftung
variants.prompt_excerpt: SHORT VERY WIDE upright ink dumpling, THREE low crown nubs under tiny cream cloth cap, TWO lower tusks. Skeptical WHITE/red/black eyes looking SIDEWAYS, huge CLOSED long pout. Hugs ONE small patched brown provision POUCH with a fat crust of BREAD sticking from opening, no mount.
variants.personality_en: He has brought provisions for the distance between the plan and the road.
variants.field_note_de: Der Proviant reicht für den Abstand zwischen Plan und Weg.

Offended strong one-brow raised direct gaze, crooked CLOSED tight-tooth smile. Tiny terracotta collar, both goo hands grip ONE thick worn wooden ROLLING PIN horizontally at own belly, no kitchen/interaction.
variants.personality_en: She would like to be consulted before becoming anyone's ideal.
